# String Editor

## Contract
The edit-format component of `StringField` — the single-line text input
every string-valued field inherits. Subclasses (Email, URL, Phone Number)
keep the editor and add validation/affordances.

Invariants:
- Edit format binds `value` attribute + input event (element-content
  binding does not clear programmatically; bind the attribute).
- Read formats render the raw string; no markdown interpretation (that is
  Markdown's job).

## Usage
Comes free with `contains(StringField)` in edit format; embedded custom
editors follow the same value+event pattern.

## Source
`https://cardstack.com/base/string` (default `StringField`, editor
included).
